name: No more Waste Hills
line: Against the landfill mountains Delhi built for itself.
deck: The best-named campaign we have. Waste hills is not a metaphor — they are visible from the road, they catch fire, and the city keeps adding to them.

holes.what: We name the target and nothing else: no year, no landfill, no demand, no outcome.
holes.unlocks: Which hill, what was asked, and of whom.

holes.what: A CityScapes walk goes to a landfill edge and we hold a photograph of it. This campaign has no photograph and no stated link to that walk.
holes.unlocks: Whether the walk is part of this campaign. If it is, the campaign has been running in plain sight with a picture already on file.
